notices.title: 重要提醒:请升级到 0.1.16
notices.message: 旧版本存在 DeepSeek 前缀缓存击穿问题,会白白消耗 token(命中率掉到个位数)。0.1.16 已重写缓存策略,不再浪费 token。请升级:npm install @a9i5k4/dsh-auto-memory@latest (pnpm 用户当天安装请用显式版本 @0.1.16)
notices.messageEn: Older versions break the DeepSeek prefix cache and waste tokens (hit rate drops to single digits). 0.1.16 rewrote the cache strategy — no more wasted tokens. Upgrade: npm install @a9i5k4/dsh-auto-memory@latest (pnpm users on release day: use @0.1.16 explicitly)

notices.title: 提前预警：下周有一次记忆架构大改版
notices.message:
这不是小更新。约 7 天后，记忆会从「按时间堆的流水账」改成以「事件」为单位——一件事一个容器，跨天能接着做，还能记住你们的共识和共同经历。

升级后如果你已有旧记忆，会提示你派一个子代理整理一次（约 10 分钟）。整理不会删除任何东西，原始记忆会先备份。
notices.titleEn: Heads-up: a major memory architecture change is coming next week
notices.messageEn:
This is not a minor update. In about a week, memory moves from a time-ordered stream to events — one container per piece of work, resumable across days, with your shared decisions and history remembered.

If you already have old memories, you will be offered a one-time cleanup by a subagent (about 10 minutes). Nothing is deleted — your originals are backed up first.
